{"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"N.A."}],"comment":"Note N3 specifies case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth, but the title-block heat_treatment field states \"N.A.\", directly contradicting it. This will confuse the shop about whether heat treatment is required; the designer must align the title block with the note."
  ,
  "recommended_correction":"Change the title-block heat_treatment field from \"N.A.\" to match the case-hardening requirement in N3, or remove N3 if no heat treatment is intended."},{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N6","page":1,"quote":"T + S NOTE : H.T.PROCESS : REF NOTE HARDNESS & DEPTH : REF NOTE FINISH & DEPTH : REF NOTE TEST COUPON SIZE : ⌀38 (20mmLENGTH - 01NOS) WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE"}],"comment":"Note N6 references hardness and depth values for a test coupon, yet the title-block heat_treatment field reads \"N.A.\", creating a contradiction about whether heat treatment applies. The machinist and inspector cannot determine which instruction governs; the designer must reconcile these entries."
  ,
  "recommended_correction":"Update the title-block heat_treatment field to reflect the heat-treatment process referenced in N6, or delete the heat-treatment references from N6 if none is required."}]}
